When I was looking through the Mexican Space Vacuum page, I have noticed that they have a colony section that has not yet been developed. This leads me to think about expanding outer space colonies of other countries (only confirmed ones like Mexico).

I was on the 22nd century page. I noticed that there was an alien species discovered in 2114 on the planet Dorado. Considering that Dorado is a name of spanish origin, I think this would be perfectly fitting to start with. The materials are all there, and I would like to tie them all together and expand on them.

While on this, I was wondering if it is possible that some Mexican colonies (if extrasolar and this idea passes) went rogue and established their own sovereign governments while others became abandoned/surrendered?

I think it is possible and makes things more interesting considering that I think some humans (and other intelligent terran species) would flee in a mass exodus and start up a new sovereign state on another planet due to some massive conflicts, some of which would go unnoticed or ignored. Personally, I think this would also set up for an interesting future plot. But for now, I have it mentally all down and prepared. Although, i guess I could've presented this better, but i had the expansion and its presentation for a while now. 

SO basically, is it possible that I am allowed to make the outer space colonies and a couple rogue colonies that became independent after the Third Mexican American War (the ones that are somehow left alone/ignored/undiscovered/not abandoned anyways)?<ac_metadata title="Status of Mexican and other Non-American space Colonies"> </ac_metadata>
